scope: Private allocation-counter build, excluded from latency and primary acceptance. Four 100-cycle controls preserve every source, syntax and geometry check. Heap snapshots remain private; only hashes, counts and a classified retainer path are published. The positive control scopes repeated WebDriver results with an owned root element. Both console-clearing controls are negative and were not adopted.

manifest.scope: Private all-owned-target GC and native allocator and retained-heap study with explicit collection checkpoints; latency acceptance and uninterrupted natural peak come from the separate normal cohort. Every transition waits for complete persisted source, syntax and current geometry. Explicit collection at checkpoints; these timings are excluded from latency acceptance. Uninterrupted natural peaks come from the normal no-GC cohort. Five-cycle smoke does not establish sustained-memory behavior. Production single-input fields retain their original observation; memoryCycles and memoryAfterCycles describe the repeated-edit cohort.
manifest.rustHeapCounters: Requested live/peak bytes and live allocation count through private GlobalAlloc wrapper, System allocator, no production feature enabled. Page heap snapshots at cycle 20 and final, profiler session retained for stable object identities; snapshots remain private.
